hero.title: Cluega AI Partner Program
hero.subhead: We're recruiting local marketing agencies, software & technology partners, and individual referrers to bring AI ad execution to their markets — together.

about.title: About Cluega AI
about.body: Cluega AI is a marketing app that uses AI to create ad creative and run ad campaigns. You don't design images, cut videos, or babysit dashboards — AI generates the creative (images, videos, copy) and autonomously handles bidding, budget, audience and on/off decisions. It includes 400+ models with Auto-routing, bills on a dual track — credits (self-serve) plus managed commission (performance) — and builds a local moat with IM private-domain attribution (e.g. WhatsApp) and the AAIGS authorization engine (M0–M5 account maturity, T0–T3 authority).

why.title: Easier to sell, deliver, and earn

turnkey.title: Turnkey AI ads + creative
turnkey.body: AI designs images, cuts videos, writes copy and runs the campaigns; 400+ models included with Auto-routing, zero setup, no BYO API — while competitors ship a single BYO model, you sell on day one.

billing.title: Performance-aligned billing
billing.body: Credits + managed commission; clients hand accounts to AI and pay on results — an order-of-magnitude discount vs. a human agency.

moat.title: A local moat
moat.body: IM attribution captures conversions platform pixels miss; a compliance-first execution layer built for your local market — a structural edge generic tools can't match.

types.title: Three partner types
types.intro: Whether you're a local agency, a software reseller, or an individual with a network, there's a path that fits.

agency.name: Local Marketing & Media-Buying Agencies
agency.who: For: performance agencies, media buyers, e-commerce ad teams
agency.body: Use Cluega to let AI auto-generate creative and run ads across many clients, scale delivery with AI, and earn a competitive revenue share.

tech.name: Software Resellers & Technology Partners
tech.who: For: SaaS resellers, software agencies, system integrators, connector builders
tech.body: Resell Cluega licenses bundled into your existing product, co-build connectors via custom MCP, and share in custom-Skill / storage projects.

referral.name: Individual & Referral Partners
referral.who: For: consultants, freelancers, KOLs, community leaders
referral.body: Refer clients and earn recurring share — no tech team or upfront cost; dedicated links, assets and tracking provided.

items: Demo accounts & ROI calculators to close on the spot
AI-generated ad creative (images / videos / copy) + fully-managed autonomous ads, process costs bundled
Priority support with dedicated Lark / Slack + SLA

model.title: How you earn
model.intro: Three revenue lines, negotiated by role, scale and managed volume. The principle: the deeper the usage and the bigger the managed spend, the more you earn.

subscription.body: Recurring share on the credit-based monthly subscriptions you resell — you keep earning as clients renew.

managed.body: Billed on ad-spend × commission; your share scales with managed volume — still far below a human agency for the client.

project.body: One-off share on enterprise custom-Skill builds (buy-out on delivery) and private-storage deployments.

model.note: Exact tiers aren't published; the full schedule is provided during onboarding after your application.

eligibility.title: Partner eligibility
eligibility.intro: Meet the criteria below to apply. We value real capability and market fit over size — individual referral partners have the lowest bar.

solution.name: Solution Partner
solution.req: A locally registered marketing / media-buying company or team; proven digital-ad experience with active clients (suggested ≥ 3 active ad accounts or steady monthly spend); capacity to serve multiple clients; and completion of Cluega platform certification.

technology.name: Technology Partner
technology.req: Software development or reselling capability with an integrable product or customer base; willingness to integrate via custom MCP connectors / API; and passing Cluega's technical and security review.

referral.name: Referral Partner
referral.req: A client network or influence in your target market (consultants, freelancers, KOLs, community leaders); no technical skills or upfront investment required; agreement to the referral terms and a dedicated tracking link.

common.label: Common requirements
common.body: Sign the partnership agreement and comply with local data regulations (PDPL / data residency); assign a dedicated point of contact; and share Cluega's performance-first, compliance-first principles.

apply.name: Apply
apply.body: Submit the application with your market, client base and partner type.

evaluate.name: Evaluate & enable
evaluate.body: A 30-minute call; we open your sandbox, enablement assets and terms.

launch.name: Launch
launch.body: Onboard first clients; we co-sell and co-deliver alongside you.

grow.name: Grow
grow.body: Your share scales with managed volume; regular reviews to optimize.

fit.title: Who it's for
items: You have local clients & media-buying experience in your own market.
You serve e-commerce, brands or performance clients and understand the ROAS game.
You want AI to generate creative and run your ads to scale delivery — without building models or infrastructure.
You value local compliance & IM private-domain (e.g. WhatsApp) conversions.

q1.q: Do I need to bring my own models or API?
q1.a: No. Cluega includes 400+ models with Auto-routing out of the box; neither you nor your clients bring an API.

q2.a: Global. IM attribution and the compliance layer are designed for local markets and can be configured for yours; we keep working with local partners in more countries and open markets progressively — let's talk.

q3.q: Can I join without a technical team?
q3.a: Yes. Individual / referral partners need no technical skills — you refer, we deliver and support.

q4.a: Three revenue lines negotiated by role, scale and managed volume; exact tiers are shared during onboarding after your application.

q5.q: Who owns the clients I bring in?
q5.a: Clients you bring in are attributed to you; private ClickHouse deployment and in-region data residency are available, supporting PDPL compliance.
